name: Brood Dam
behaviour: Nest-mother that holds her nest. Every seven to nine seconds she swells for 1.6 s and hatches two Brood Hatchlings, up to three alive. While she lives every creep of her nest within 12 m moves faster and hits harder and the nest restocks quicker; killing her scatters the brood. Up close she slams a 3 m circle for 16.
look: Armoured, horned nest-mother with a huge glowing egg-sac slung behind her.
